match_nodes.description: A Strategic Compass for Security and Defence (EU)

data.official_name: A Strategic Compass for Security and Defence — For a European Union that protects its citizens, values and interests and contributes to international peace and security
alternate_names: Strategic Compass for Security and Defence
data.description: Overarching European Union security and defence strategy adopted by the Council of the European Union on March 21, 2022 and endorsed by the European Council on March 25, 2022, setting an action plan through 2030 across four pillars: Act, Secure (including the EU Cyber Defence Policy and Hybrid Toolbox), Invest, and Partner.
data.notes: Reviewed annually via Joint Progress Reports published by the High Representative / EEAS and the European Commission.

urls.note: EEAS Strategic Compass portal and annual progress reports

versions_available.note: Adopted by the Council of the European Union on March 21, 2022 (ST 7371/22).

data.description: Joint Communications of the European Commission and the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy defining the European Union's strategic framework for cyber resilience, operational capacity, NIS2/CRA regulatory reform, and global cyber diplomacy.
data.notes: Three editions issued: 2013 (JOIN(2013) 1 final), 2017 (JOIN(2017) 450 final), and December 16, 2020 (JOIN(2020) 18 final, 'The EU's Cybersecurity Strategy for the Digital Decade').
